name: Aztec Gems Megaways

features.name: Multiplier reel
features.description: A multiplier from 1x to 100x lands on every spin and applies to all wins.

features.name: Megaways mini-grid
features.description: Reels 1–3 hold 2–8 symbols each for up to 512 ways.

review:
A compact Megaways game: reels 1 to 3 show two to eight symbols each (up to 512 ways), and the fourth reel is just multipliers. One lands every spin – 1x up to 100x – and applies to every win on the grid.

Because there's always a multiplier, even a small win can occasionally become a big one. No traditional free spins – just fast, simple spins. 10,000x max and a 96.58% RTP, one of Pragmatic's best.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
